title: Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Uruguay, made with tender beef and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: uruguayan seasoning
ingredients.notes: available at most Latin American markets

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the browned beef back to the pot, along with the salt, black pepper, and uruguayan seasoning.
Pour in 2 cups of beef broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
